summary: Reviewed docs/design/validate_system.py and docs/runs/design-foundation/check_figma.py against AC-1–AC-4 and the frozen manifests/recorded exports. The token validator checks layers, aliases, cycles, types, mode coverage, deterministic CSS, contrast, variant count/states and permission-action invariants. The Figma checker verifies target receipt, variable scopes/values/aliases/CSS, style bindings, variant inventory, expected variable-ID presence, screenshot hashes and final audit, and now states its property-level assurance limit accurately. Both required commands exit 0 on the frozen inputs. The corrected PermissionRequest export additionally records property-keyed badge/text fills matching the info token IDs. No actionable code defect remains.
review_boundary: Deterministic local validators and recorded Figma evidence; no runtime app exists.
evidence_limits: Generic variant checking proves expected variable IDs occur within variant nodes, not exact property placement for every role; the script now says so. Static evidence does not establish live UI interaction or OS/network behavior.
